Data from our latest Petroleum Supply Monthly includes data through June 2026. The U.S. refining fleet produces several fuels.
From January through June 2026, refinery yields of gasoline have averaged less than 47%.
The U.S. refinery fleet exceeded an average jet fuel yield of 11% for the first time in April 2026. Since then, the fleetwide average jet fuel yield has remained at or above 11% through the latest Petroleum Supply Monthly data for June 2026.
Particularly high refinery margins for distillate fuel oil and jet fuel have contributed to shifts in the refinery yields of major products in 2026.
